The '''cybernetic chamber''' was a device developed by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A large chamber about the size of a starfighter cockpit, it had a single seat within it and used a laserwave link to transmit [[The Force/Legends|Force]] energies long distances, creating a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] link. Wired into a probe droid, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] could tap into the minds of people within range of the droid, even if it were [[Light-year/Legends|light-years]] away.

Darth Vader used this chamber in a plan to uncover a hidden [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] base after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. Luring [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to [[Verdanth]], Vader hoped to use the chamber's Force energy to pry the location from his mind. However, Skywalker resisted the probe.
